updateserver.name: Visitor Stats
updateserver.desc: See who has been visiting your websites: visitors per day and month, pages, referrers, search terms, browsers and the busiest hours, made every hour with Visitors 0.7.
updateserver.updatedesc: Fixes reports that were made but never shown (the reports folder was closed to the panel): the update repairs it at once. Includes the panel-style page and the report in Light or Dark.
